title: The Field Brief
blurb: Daily scout surface for CR-Harness and adjacent agent-control research. Public sources only. Not an hourly Cao-style feed — refresh ~daily.

entries.title: AutoHarness: synthesize code that blocks illegal moves
entries.summary: DeepMind (Lou et al.): Gemini-2.5-Flash iteratively synthesizes an is_legal_action / propose_action code harness via Thompson-sampling tree search over environment feedback. Claims 100% legal-action rate across 145 TextArena games; smaller Flash+harness beats larger Pro on many 1P/2P evals. Direct analogue to CR-Harness legal_actions at decision_point.
entries.why_it_matters_for_cr: CR already whitelists legal_actions — AutoHarness shows how to auto-build or regression-test that verifier from env feedback, and how illegal-move rate dominates LLM game losses.

entries.title: PTCG-Bench: legal-action masking swings card-game ratings
entries.summary: Hua et al.: Pokémon TCG benchmark for LLM agents with modular harness ablations (structured obs, legal-action masking, history). Removing legal-action masking drops Glicko-2 by ~118 points and raises invalid-action rate to ~16%. Self-evolution across rounds stays unstable. Closest public TCG analogue to Mini Royale decision_points.
entries.why_it_matters_for_cr: Quantifies how much of ‘LLM skill’ is really the mask + observation schema — exactly what CR’s legal_actions + ETL should report per model–harness pair.

entries.title: Adversarial Review: structured disagreement beats naive dual LGTM
entries.summary: Qiu & Gill (arXiv:2608.18167): reviewer + critic protocol; naive AR collapses into false consensus; three-way critic verdicts (AGREE / DISAGREE_EVIDENCE / DISAGREE_CONCERN) lift SWE-PRBench F1. Portable as SKILL.md. Maps onto fleet blind dual-LGTM (Astra + second seat).
entries.why_it_matters_for_cr: Fleet coding loop already wants blind dual LGTM; AR’s typed disagreement is a concrete protocol upgrade for Github Bot EM / Manage review babysitting — also useful when reviewing CR cockpit/eval PRs.

entries.title: Harness-Bench: report model–harness pairs, not models alone
entries.summary: Qihoo360 Harness-Bench (arXiv:2605.27922): 106 sandboxed agent tasks; 5194 trajectories show large variance across model–harness pairings. Flags execution-alignment failures (reasoning decoupled from tool feedback / workspace state).
entries.why_it_matters_for_cr: CR batch evals should score (model, prompt, legal_actions schema, retry policy) as one config — not attribute wins to the LLM alone.

entries.title: Harbor Adapters + Harbor-Index: unified agentic eval infra
entries.summary: arXiv:2609.04298 — adapters for 80+ agentic benchmarks; Harbor-Index curated hard subset (82 tasks / 29 benches). Strongest reported config ~28% pass. Useful pattern for wrapping CR sim + external benches under one runner.
entries.why_it_matters_for_cr: Inspiration for a thin CR eval adapter that can sit beside TextArena/PTCG-style benches without rewriting the cockpit.

entries.title: MemArbiter: decision-time memory arbitration (Memory-Action Gap)
entries.summary: arXiv:2608.02113 — five functional memory banks (Goal, Task State, Constraint, Episodic, Reference) with focal/ambient presentation gated per step. Large ALFWorld gains under tight token budgets; reduces failed-action repetition.
entries.why_it_matters_for_cr: Match memory at each decision_point should be budgeted (elixir history, last N plays, constraints) rather than dumping full ETL into the prompt.

entries.title: TextArena: 100+ text games + show_valid legal-move hints
entries.summary: Public Gym-style suite (Guertler et al.; github.com/textarena/textarena). Environments expose validation, set_invalid_move, optional show_valid legal lists. Used by AutoHarness; also hosts MindGames / SPIRAL self-play work.
entries.why_it_matters_for_cr: Cheap public sandbox to prototype legal_actions UX and illegal-move telemetry before touching private Mini Royale.

entries.title: Hasty-CR: CR simulator with legal-tile masks (RL, not LLM)
entries.summary: Public Clash Royale–style simulator + Maskable PPO agent (hastylmao/Hasty-CR). Explicit legal-tile masking so policy cannot place illegally; exploit_probe hunts simulator bugs that look like wins. Honest: no LLM in the decision path.
entries.why_it_matters_for_cr: Pattern reference for CR’s spatial legal mask + anti-cheating eval probes — transfer ideas, not the RL stack.

entries.title: ClashGPT: CV + Maskable PPO on live Clash Royale (pixels)
entries.summary: EzraGil08/ClashGPT — dual YOLOv11 + SORT + Maskable PPO via emulator clicks. Real CR, not a clean sim. Thin for LLM control research; useful as existence proof of action-masking in CR-shaped spaces.
entries.why_it_matters_for_cr: Contrast case: pixel bots need masks too. CR-Harness’s structured state + legal_actions is the cleaner research surface.

entries.title: Board Game Arena: LLM agents on OpenSpiel with illegal-move metrics
entries.summary: arXiv:2508.03368 — wraps OpenSpiel board/matrix games for LLM agents (LiteLLM/vLLM/Ray). Tracks illegal/suboptimal moves and decision optimality vs equilibrium policies.
entries.why_it_matters_for_cr: Metric vocabulary (illegal rate, optimality vs baseline) to borrow for CR cockpit batch reports.

entries.title: HarnessDev / Evo-Bench: can models evolve their own harness?
entries.summary: HarnessDev (arXiv PDF 2609.01437) and Evo-Bench (2608.09096) shift eval from task outputs to runnable harness creation/evolution. Gains are unstable and transfer partially across models — cautionary for auto-rewriting CR’s control loop.
entries.why_it_matters_for_cr: Watch-list only: fleet should not auto-mutate CR legal_actions / ETL without human gate + Three-Run Proof.
